notes:
SySHIP now has a command line: run HULL and COMPART from scripts, your own programs, or an AI agent.

## Highlights

- **`syship` command line**: load and vary hulls, model compartments, set loading and damage, and run stability from a terminal. Commands run in the open SySHIP window so you can watch every step, or in a headless instance for batch work. The Windows installer adds `syship` to your PATH. See [Command Line](https://syship.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli/).
- **Stability criteria as scripts**: every criterion (IMO IS Code 2008, MARPOL Annex I Reg.28, ICLL Reg.27) is a short construction script on the GZ curve. Open one to see its lines, points and areas drawn on the chart, edit it, or write your own. The curve fit can be linear, cubic spline or PCHIP.
- **Rule library (.rule files)**: import and export criteria as `.rule` files to share them, one rule per file. Built-in rules can be edited and restored to the original at any time.
- **Stability**: the equilibrium heel, trim and draft are solved directly, and the GZ curve covers -90° to 90° with free trim. Partly filled tanks shift as the ship heels (free-surface effect), and flooded compartments use their permeability exactly. The default heel step is 5°.
- **HULL fairing**: check TPEF around a vertex and move vertices one at a time. FFD and fairing can no longer change L, B or D.
- Hydrostatics run on 8 threads, and scripts, hydrostatics and stability runs show their progress.

## Changes

- Auto smooth has been removed from Fairing.
- Undo and Redo for Variation and Fairing are in the bottom bar instead of each panel.
- Openings (down-flooding points) are no longer modeled.
- Fixed: digits typed into the lightship weight and CG fields were sometimes lost.
